title: Move scanner behavior specs with the engine
description:
As an eval author, I want scan-findings and scanner-recall Gherkin to live in the scanner project, so that behavior specs score the library.

Feature: specs follow the engine

  Scenario: Recall feature moves
    Given features/scan-findings.feature and features/scanner-recall-evaluation.feature
    When the scanner project is stood up
    Then those features and their steps run there
    And gold-import / local-graphql / CLI-only features stay or move only if they are eval infra
